fact: A September 2025 World Bank mission found the consultancy assessing the government data centre offered options of requalifying the current data centre (about EUR 0.5 million) or building a new TIER III data centre (about EUR 4.6 million), and recommended migrating GdeSTP systems and data to a new data centre or cloud controlled by INIC because of high risks at the current one.
title: Missão de Apoio a Implementação para o Projecto Digital São Tomé e Príncipe: Ajuda Memória (P177158)
